what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Egypt in Greece: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 6138 Egyptian asylum seekers in Greece, 13.3% of all asylum seekers from Egypt.
Refugees from Egypt, a separate group, live mostly in the United States, France, Germany and the United Kingdom.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict with the Islamic State group in Egypt from 2015 to 2022.
It also records armed conflict over the government of Egypt in 1998, 2014 and 2017 to 2019.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2003 at 20 asylum seekers.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2024 and 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Greece.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Greece only.
